capability_mapping.media.ffmpeg: run_command to local ffmpeg/ffprobe when available

high.recommended: select the strongest practical High reasoning configuration for the chosen model; for headless Gemini runs use an available high model slug and/or --effort high

execution.recommended: use a capable execution setting; Medium may be suitable for routine/substantial implementation, but resolve to High for critical milestones

fast.recommended: use only for bounded low-risk helper work, never independent audit/review or critical implementation

adaptive.recommended: classify implementation milestone first; routine/substantial -> execution unless a forced-high trigger fires; critical -> high
